tools.title: Tools
tools.intro: Everything runs in your browser. Your files are never sent anywhere.

merge.name: Merge PDF
merge.desc: Combine several PDF files into one, in the order you choose.

split.name: Split PDF
split.desc: Split one PDF into several files by page range or page by page.

extract-pages.name: Extract pages
extract-pages.desc: Pull the pages you choose into a new PDF.

delete-pages.name: Delete pages
delete-pages.desc: Remove one or more pages from a PDF.

rotate-pages.name: Rotate pages
rotate-pages.desc: Rotate PDF pages to portrait or landscape.

organize-pages.name: Organize pages
organize-pages.desc: Preview pages, drag to reorder, rotate or delete visually.

protect.name: Protect with password
protect.desc: Set an open password on a PDF (AES-256 encryption).

unlock.name: Unlock PDF
unlock.desc: Remove the password from a PDF when you know it.

compress.name: Compress PDF
compress.desc: Reduce size by optimizing the file structure, with no quality loss.

crop-pages.name: Crop pages
crop-pages.desc: Trim the margins of PDF pages in millimeters.

page-numbers.name: Page numbers
page-numbers.desc: Add page numbers to a PDF; choose position, size and style.

watermark.name: Add watermark
watermark.desc: Stamp text or a faded image on PDF pages.

images-to-pdf.name: Images to PDF
images-to-pdf.desc: Combine several JPG/PNG images into one PDF, one image per page.

text-to-pdf.name: TXT to PDF
text-to-pdf.desc: Turn a text file into a PDF, keeping accented characters intact.

pdf-to-images.name: PDF to images
pdf-to-images.desc: Turn each PDF page into a PNG or JPG image, downloaded as a zip.

image-resize.name: Resize image
image-resize.desc: Shrink or enlarge images by percentage or pixels.

image-rotate.name: Rotate and flip image
image-rotate.desc: Rotate 90°, 180°, 270° and flip horizontally or vertically.

image-crop.name: Crop image
image-crop.desc: Choose the area to keep with a draggable frame or pixel values.

image-compress.name: Compress image
image-compress.desc: Reduce image size at the quality level you choose.

image-convert.name: Convert image format
image-convert.desc: Convert images to PNG, JPG, WebP, TIFF or AVIF.

image-enhance.name: Enhance image
image-enhance.desc: Interpolated upscaling, sharpening and color balance (classic algorithms, no AI).

image-remove-bg.name: Remove background
image-remove-bg.desc: Make a plain-color background transparent and export PNG.

image-erase.name: Erase object from image
image-erase.desc: Paint over an unwanted object; the area is filled from the surrounding colors.

image-to-png.name: Image to PNG
image-to-png.desc: Convert any image to PNG, keeping full quality.

image-to-jpg.name: Image to JPG
image-to-jpg.desc: Convert an image to JPG; transparent areas become white.

image-to-webp.name: Image to WebP
image-to-webp.desc: Convert an image to compact WebP, keeping transparency.

image-to-tiff.name: Image to TIFF
image-to-tiff.desc: Convert an image to uncompressed TIFF, keeping every pixel.

image-to-avif.name: Image to AVIF (HEIF substitute)
image-to-avif.desc: Convert an image to AVIF, from the HEIF family. Browsers have no free HEIF/HEVC encoder, so AVIF is used.

annotate.name: Annotate PDF
annotate.desc: Draw, highlight, add notes, shapes and arrows on PDF pages.

edit.name: Edit PDF
edit.desc: Add text, images, checkboxes, shapes and cover areas with white boxes.

sign.name: Sign PDF
sign.desc: Insert a signature (drawn, typed or image), initials, date and checkboxes.

redact.name: Redact (cover sensitive info)
redact.desc: Permanently cover areas with sensitive information. Pages with redactions become images, so the text underneath is no longer in the file.

repair.name: Repair PDF
repair.desc: Recover a PDF with mild structural damage (bad reference table, cut-off end) into a clean file.

ocr.name: Text recognition (OCR)
ocr.desc: Turn a scanned PDF or a photo into a PDF with selectable, searchable text. Runs on your device.

convert.name: Convert PDF
convert.desc: Choose a file and we suggest the formats it can be converted to.

docx-to-pdf.name: Word to PDF
docx-to-pdf.desc: Convert a Word document (.docx) to PDF, keeping headings, paragraphs, lists and tables.

xlsx-to-pdf.name: Excel to PDF
xlsx-to-pdf.desc: Convert an Excel workbook (.xlsx) to PDF, one table per sheet.

pptx-to-pdf.name: PowerPoint to PDF
pptx-to-pdf.desc: Convert a presentation (.pptx) to PDF, one page per slide.

pdf-to-docx.name: PDF to Word
pdf-to-docx.desc: Turn a PDF into an editable Word document that keeps fonts, sizes, colors, alignment, lists, tables, columns and images.

pdf-to-xlsx.name: PDF to Excel
pdf-to-xlsx.desc: Turn tables and text in a PDF into Excel spreadsheet cells.

pdf-to-pptx.name: PDF to PowerPoint
pdf-to-pptx.desc: Turn each PDF page into a slide, with the page text in the notes.

ranges.label: Pages
ranges.hint: Example: 1-3, 5, 8- (8- means page 8 to the end)
ranges.splitHint: Each range becomes one file. Example: 1-3, 4-10
ranges.allHint: Leave empty to rotate all pages. Example: 1-3, 5
ranges.allCropHint: Leave empty to crop all pages. Example: 1-3, 5
ranges.allNumberHint: Leave empty to number all pages. Example: 2-10
ranges.allWatermarkHint: Leave empty to apply to all pages. Example: 1-3

password.label: Password
password.protectHint: Remember this password: it can't be recovered if you forget it.

watermark.textHint: Leave empty if you add a PNG/JPG image together with the PDF for an image watermark.

resize.pixelsHint: Used with "Pixels". Leave one box at 0 to calculate it from the aspect ratio.

quality.label: Quality (1–100)
quality.hint: Lower is smaller but loses quality. PNG reduces colors instead of quality.
quality.convertHint: Applies to JPG, WebP, AVIF. PNG and TIFF are lossless.

enhance.levelsHint: Stretches light and dark in each color channel.

removeBg.hint: The background color is taken from the image edges. Raise it if background remains, lower it if the subject is cut away.

ocr.hint: The first use downloads language data (~10 MB) and keeps it for offline use. Pick the right language for better accuracy.

editor.hint: Drag and drop, or use the buttons under each page to reorder, rotate or delete.

editor.loadingText: Reading the text on the page…
editor.noText: This page has no text to edit (it may be a scan). Use Text recognition (OCR) first.
editor.sourceFont: Original font: {{name}}. New text uses an equivalent font with the same metrics.

warnings.edit-cover-only: In some places the original text could not be removed (for example text inside a pre-assembled block, so the new text is only placed on top). The old text is no longer visible but is still in the file and can be copied; use Redact if it must be removed completely.
warnings.font-fallback: The font you picked lacks some characters, so DejaVu Sans was used for that text.
warnings.docx-images-skipped: Some images in the PDF use an unsupported encoding and could not be placed in the Word file.
warnings.docx-scan-image-removed: The scanned pages already have an OCR text layer: the scan image was replaced with the recognized text so it can be edited in Word; figures detected inside the scan are kept as images in place. Please check the text against the original.
